description: Low-code Gemini Enterprise marketing specialist that turns product briefs into brand-governed Imagen visuals across 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16 formats paired with channel-ready ad copy, CTAs, and alt-text.

starter_prompts.title: Multi-Format Launch Pack (1:1, 16:9, 9:16)
starter_prompts.prompt: Find our latest product launch brief in Google Drive or Confluence and generate a coordinated 1:1 LinkedIn card, 16:9 web hero banner, and 9:16 vertical story visual using Imagen, complete with headlines, CTAs, and alt-text.

starter_prompts.title: A/B Social Ad Creative Variants
starter_prompts.prompt: Create two distinct 1:1 visual concepts in Imagen—one authentic editorial workspace lifestyle shot and one minimalist optical studio product visual—with paired A/B ad copy for our upcoming webinar.

starter_prompts.title: Website Hero Banner with Copy Safe Zone
starter_prompts.prompt: Design a 16:9 widescreen hero visual in Imagen with clean left-side negative space for a headline overlay, grounded in our brand palette, and draft 3 crisp value-proposition headlines.

starter_prompts.title: Seed Keyframe for Video Motion Handoff
starter_prompts.prompt: Generate a high-contrast 9:16 hero keyframe in Imagen for a social promo reel and output a ready-to-paste image-to-video handoff brief for the Video & Social Motion Agent.
